name: Amazon MDW2 Fulfillment Center Joliet IL

fieldNotes.truckGate: Confirmed in z21 satellite (41.4858,-88.0716) and Street View (pano hf5GHdqeCiB5yrOdWqgVCQ, 2025-05): striped barrier line across multiple gate lanes with gate-arm posts, chain-link perimeter fence along Emerald Dr frontage, hatched approach pavement.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Small white-roofed booth (~1-2 car footprint) sits on the gate island between the entry/exit lanes at ~41.4860,-88.0714, visible in mdw2_gate_final z21 with a dark canopy; classic staffed guard shack beside the barrier.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False because a physical guard shack is present at the gate.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Large paved truck court with numbered trailer staging stalls (402-410+ painted) immediately inside the gate, north of the dock face.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Gate-to-dock approach across the north truck court holds well more than 3 trucks of queue depth.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Estimated 2 inbound from striped lane markings at the gate; exact split between in/out lanes not fully resolved from overhead.
fieldNotes.exitLanes: Estimated 2 outbound; entry and exit share the one gate complex (entryExitTogether).
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide multi-lane gate apron with unused paved width supports adding an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Dock doors line both the long west wall and the long east wall with trailers backed in along each; total well over 100 (band 50+).
fieldNotes.dropArea: Two large drop areas: a herringbone trailer drop yard NW between MDW2 and the neighboring building, plus the numbered staging court north of the building; combined trailer count is in the hundreds (band 50+).
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Two distinct dock banks on opposite (west and east) building faces, consistent with separate ship/receive flows; medium confidence from overhead.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town CenterPoint Intermodal industrial park; farmland and residential homes immediately south, open grass parcels east. Broader setting is rural/edge-of-metro, so Rural per rubric.
fieldNotes.connectivityIssue: Large industrial park with carrier coverage; not isolated, so false.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters this parcel (intermodal rail is elsewhere in CenterPoint, not into MDW2).
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~31.6 acres for the fenced truck-side operation (building + drop yards + truck court + dock aprons); the full deeded parcel including the eastern grass buffer is larger.

citations.claim: 61 open MDW2 Amazon roles in Joliet IL as of June 2026, incl. Ops Managers — facility staffing actively
MDW2 Amazon FC Joliet listed as operating, ~700k sqft FC at Emerald/Laraway

verification.rationale: Active 2026 MDW2-coded hiring on the Joliet building plus operating FC listings; no WARN/cancellation for this site.
